_what: P(a stopped Vast box ever resumes), measured from every committed revision of this repo's per-tick fleet census. The derivation behind MAX_STOPPED_MIN / the teardown_decision hold backstop.
_method: git log --all over the census files -> per-instance cur_state trajectory at tick resolution -> maximal stopped episodes -> did a later tick show the SAME instance running? Censoring is explicit: our own reaper removes most stopped boxes.
_censoring_warning: p_resume_over_all_episodes is a LOWER BOUND. Episodes marked `censored` ended because the box left the census (we destroyed it, or Vast did), not because we watched it fail to resume.

all._p_resume_lower_bound_means: resumed / ALL episodes. A lower bound only: the censored episodes did not fail to resume, we stopped watching them.

never_started._p_resume_lower_bound_means: resumed / ALL episodes. A lower bound only: the censored episodes did not fail to resume, we stopped watching them.

paused_after_running._p_resume_lower_bound_means: resumed / ALL episodes. A lower bound only: the censored episodes did not fail to resume, we stopped watching them.

_recommended_hold_min_rule: the LONGEST time-to-resume actually observed among never-started boxes, plus one median census tick, rounded up to 5 min. Never extrapolated past the observed maximum, and not set at all from fewer than 5 observed resumes (then it is None and the constant is left alone). Derivation: vast_stopped_resume_measure.recommended_hold_min.
